0022600160.text: The Hawks (3-4) are second in the Southeast, half a game back, and enter on a one-game losing streak after going 1-2 at home and 2-2 on the road. The Pacers (2-4) are third in the Central, three games back and 12th in the East, having lost three straight and gone 0-2 at home. Henri Veesaar and Mouhamed Gueye are out for Atlanta, and Jalen Johnson and Jock Landale are day-to-day with game-time decisions. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, Obi Toppin, T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Hawks won the 2025-26 series 2-1, though they lost the last meeting 129-124 in Indianapolis on January 31.
